signal: Fivetran and dbt Labs completed their merger in June 2026, creating a combined data infrastructure company for AI agents.

email.subject1: a signal play for dbt Labs
email.body1:
Joel, saw dbt Labs and Fivetran just closed your merger to build the data layer for trusted AI agents.

Combining two GTM motions usually means more enterprise accounts in play than the team can cover while the org integrates, and that is exactly where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for dbt Labs off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: meetings to cover the merged book
email.body2:
Joel, quick follow-up for dbt Labs.

Post-merger, the combined target list typically grows faster than enterprise reps can ramp, so accounts go untouched and the integration quarter quietly leaks pipeline. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to cover it.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings dbt Labs needs to cover the merged book this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Joel, last bit of proof for dbt Labs.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M dollars in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how dbt Labs reply rate likely compares to other data-infrastructure companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Joel, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise coverage without adding headcount is not a priority during the integration, no problem at all. The post-merger stretch is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your enterprise motion? I will tailor it to dbt Labs either way.
